remarks: Welcome to Prospect Gardens, Norwalk's most affordable property option! This investor-special comes with existing cash flow, featuring a tenant already in place with an impeccable payment history. This one-bedroom, one-bath condo is in excellent condition. Enter into the living room, which offers ample space for entertaining. The eat-in kitchen has plenty of room for a table and bar, as well as lots of cabinets and counter space compared to similar-sized condos. The primary bedroom is spacious and bright, with plenty of windows throughout the unit. There is one reserved parking spot and laundry facilities in the complex for owners. The driveway is in the process of being replaced. All of this is situated close to everything Norwalk has to offer-SONO Collection is down the road, the Norwalk River Valley Trail is less than half a mile away, and the Connector, Merritt Parkway, SONO, and the beach are all nearby. Come see this unit quickly before someone else gets it!
